card.name: Small words right before "risk"
card.fires_on: The small linking words "to" or "the" that come just before the word "risk" or "risks", mostly in warning text such as "exposes users to the risks of" or "due to risk of".

modes.label: exposes users to the
modes.description: The word "the" after "exposes users/patients to" in addiction, abuse and misuse warnings.
modes.example: As an opioid, OLINVYK exposes users to<< the>> risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse

modes.label: due to / reduce the
modes.description: The word "to" after "due", or "the" after "reduce", where "risk of" comes next.
modes.example: This product, as all chewable tablets, is not recommended for children under age 4 due<< to>> risk of choking.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "risk" or "risks" as the next word, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before "risk", when the sentence is about to name a risk.
